Method of Attack: BAT script that searches disks and specific directories for various filetypes and archives them using WinRAR with the '-df' command-line option to delete files as they are archived, then deletes the archives to destroy data on Windows devices
Run through a scheduled task created and distributed via group policies on Windows domain
Discoverer: Ukrainian Government Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-UA)
Attack Vector: Compromised VPN accounts without multi-factor authentication
Indicators of Compromise: Modified version of RoarBat linked to previous Sandworm attack on Ukrinform
